top_signals.title: Canelo Alvarez reaffirms love for boxing after reclaiming super-middleweight title
top_signals.summary: The bout went ahead in Riyadh after a week in which the Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted Iran-aligned Houthi missiles and drones aimed at the capital.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
